text: Phek district ( FEK) is a district in the Indian state of Nagaland. At 2,026 square kilometres (782 sq mi) and with 163,418 inhabitants, it is the seventh-most populous district in Nagaland and 596th most populous district in India. The district is home to 8.26% population of Nagaland. The town of Phek is the district headquarter, located 120 kilometres from Kohima, the capital of Nagaland and the largest urban centre is Pfütsero.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
